method: Three fresh Python processes per mode; complete one-short predict includes tokenizer, graph setup, copies, inference and formatting. Existing local weights/native extensions and warm OS file cache. Fresh compiler caches are new empty directories. Hub networking disabled. StableHostAdapter applied to every mode. No serving HTTP.
build_scope: Observed one-time exports/builds with existing development caches; separate from deployment startup. Each artifact embeds a separate copy of the model weights.

validation.scope: Tokenizer preparation checked across the complete reference suite. AOT model math checked on 24 deterministic tensor-value variants at each of two fixed shapes, not all 66 full inference requests.

dependencies.runtime: Python Torch with registered exact LayerNorm/GELU custom ops; prebuilt native norm and host extensions. The model artifact is loaded by the C++ package loader, but this is not a Python-free executable.

findings: Strict torch.export captures the raw Triton kernels; the non-strict export failure is retained.
Export uses the actual packed host input layout, avoiding an automatic marker-mask alignment copy.

The high-level package loader performs a CPU compiler feature probe. The checked C++ loader verifies the recorded platform, Torch version, CPU instructions, GPU architecture and math-library identity without invoking that probe.
All final AOT runs left both compiler cache directories empty.
Direct serialized Rust tokenizer loading exactly matches AutoTokenizer preparation on all 66 reference requests.
AOT reduces deployment setup; its steady-state request latency is approximately the same as the compiled model.
limitations: Only the two listed shape and mask specializations are built. Other requests are explicitly rejected; this is not a general dynamic-shape replacement.
The package uses version-pinned private PyTorch APIs and external custom-op registrations.
Each shape artifact is approximately 958 MB because model weights are currently duplicated.
Synthetic parity checks are not a labeled model-quality evaluation.

diagnostic_directories.request-matrix: Preliminary AutoTokenizer and high-level-loader measurements. Controls did not force Hub offline; do not use for final startup comparisons.
diagnostic_directories.request-fast-matrix: Preliminary checked-loader measurements before lightweight tokenizer and stable-adapter finalization.
diagnostic_directories.final-request-matrix: Interrupted after initial runs to enforce fully offline controls.
